verses.en: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
verses.pt: Ao homem pertencem os planos do coração; mas a resposta da língua é do Senhor.
verses.en_web: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: The designs of the heart are man's, but the answer of the tongue comes from the Lord.

verses.en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.pt: Todos os caminhos do homem são limpos aos seus olhos; mas o Senhor pesa os espíritos.
verses.en_web: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.
verses.en_bbe: All a man's ways are clean to himself; but the Lord puts men's spirits into his scales.

verses.en: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.pt: Entrega ao Senhor as tuas obras, e teus desígnios serão estabelecidos.
verses.en_web: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
verses.en_bbe: Put your works into the hands of the Lord, and your purposes will be made certain.

verses.en: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.pt: O Senhor fez tudo para um fim; sim, até o ímpio para o dia do mal.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has made everything for his purpose, even the sinner for the day of evil.

verses.en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.pt: Todo homem arrogante é abominação ao Senhor; certamente não ficará impune.
verses.en_web: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
verses.en_bbe: Everyone who has pride in his heart is disgusting to the Lord: he will certainly not go free from punishment.

verses.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
verses.pt: Pela misericórdia e pela verdade expia-se a iniqüidade; e pelo temor do Senhor os homens se desviam do mal.
verses.en_web: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
verses.en_bbe: By mercy and good faith evil-doing is taken away: and by the fear of the Lord men are turned away from evil.

verses.en: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.pt: Quando os caminhos do homem agradam ao Senhor, faz que até os seus inimigos tenham paz com ele.
verses.en_web: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.en_bbe: When a man's ways are pleasing to the Lord, he makes even his haters be at peace with him.

verses.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.pt: Melhor é o pouco com justiça, do que grandes rendas com injustiça.
verses.en_web: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
verses.en_bbe: Better is a little with righteousness, than great wealth with wrongdoing.

verses.en: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.pt: O coração do homem propõe o seu caminho; mas o Senhor lhe dirige os passos.
verses.en_web: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
verses.en_bbe: A man may make designs for his way, but the Lord is the guide of his steps.

verses.en: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.pt: Nos lábios do rei acham-se oráculos; em juízo a sua boca não prevarica.
verses.en_web: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Decision is in the lips of the king: his mouth will not go wrong in judging.

verses.en: A just weight and balance are the LORD’S: all the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.pt: O peso e a balança justos são do Senhor; obra sua são todos os pesos da bolsa.
verses.en_web: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
verses.en_bbe: True measures and scales are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work.

verses.en: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.pt: Abominação é para os reis o praticarem a impiedade; porque com justiça se estabelece o trono.
verses.en_web: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: Evil-doing is disgusting to kings: for the seat of the ruler is based on righteousness.

verses.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.pt: Lábios justos são o prazer dos reis; e eles amam aquele que fala coisas retas.
verses.en_web: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
verses.en_bbe: Lips of righteousness are the delight of kings; and he who says what is upright is dear to him.

verses.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.pt: O furor do rei é mensageiro da morte; mas o homem sábio o aplacará.
verses.en_web: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.en_bbe: The wrath of the king is like those who give news of death, but a wise man will put peace in place of it.

verses.en: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.pt: Na luz do semblante do rei está a vida; e o seu favor é como a nuvem de chuva serôdia.
verses.en_web: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
verses.en_bbe: In the light of the king's face there is life; and his approval is like a cloud of spring rain.

verses.en: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.pt: Quanto melhor é adquirir a sabedoria do que o ouro! e quanto mais excelente é escolher o entendimento do que a prata!
verses.en_web: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
verses.en_bbe: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! and to get knowledge is more to be desired than silver.

verses.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.pt: A estrada dos retos desvia-se do mal; o que guarda o seu caminho preserva a sua vida.
verses.en_web: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
verses.en_bbe: The highway of the upright is to be turned away from evil: he who takes care of his way will keep his soul.

verses.en: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.pt: A soberba precede a destruição, e a altivez do espírito precede a queda.
verses.en_web: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.en_bbe: Pride goes before destruction, and a stiff spirit before a fall.

verses.en: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.pt: Melhor é ser humilde de espírito com os mansos, do que repartir o despojo com os soberbos.
verses.en_web: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
verses.en_bbe: Better it is to have a gentle spirit with the poor, than to take part in the rewards of war with men of pride.

verses.en: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
verses.pt: O que atenta prudentemente para a palavra prosperará; e feliz é aquele que confia no Senhor.
verses.en_web: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
verses.en_bbe: He who gives attention to the law of right will get good; and whoever puts his faith in the Lord is happy.

verses.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.pt: O sábio de coração será chamado prudente; e a doçura dos lábios aumenta o saber.
verses.en_web: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
verses.en_bbe: The wise-hearted will be named men of good sense: and by pleasing words learning is increased.

verses.en: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.pt: O entendimento, para aquele que o possui, é uma fonte de vida, porém a estultícia é o castigo dos insensatos.
verses.en_web: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
verses.en_bbe: Wisdom is a fountain of life to him who has it; but the punishment of the foolish is their foolish behaviour.

verses.en: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.pt: O coração do sábio instrui a sua boca, e aumenta o saber nos seus lábios.
verses.en_web: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
verses.en_bbe: The heart of the wise man is the teacher of his mouth, and gives increased learning to his lips.

verses.en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.pt: Palavras suaves são como favos de mel, doçura para a alma e saúde para o corpo.
verses.en_web: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.en_bbe: Pleasing words are like honey, sweet to the soul and new life to the bones.

verses.en: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.pt: Há um caminho que ao homem parece direito, mas o fim dele conduz à morte.
verses.en_web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.en_bbe: There is a way which seems straight before a man, but its end is the ways of death.

verses.en: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.pt: O apetite do trabalhador trabalha por ele, porque a sua fome o incita a isso.
verses.en_web: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
verses.en_bbe: The desire of the working man is working for him, for his need of food is driving him on.

verses.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.pt: O homem vil suscita o mal; e nos seus lábios há como que um fogo ardente.
verses.en_web: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
verses.en_bbe: A good-for-nothing man is a designer of evil, and in his lips there is a burning fire.

verses.en: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.pt: O homem perverso espalha contendas; e o difamador separa amigos íntimos.
verses.en_web: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
verses.en_bbe: A man of twisted purposes is a cause of fighting everywhere: and he who says evil secretly makes trouble between friends.

verses.en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
verses.pt: O homem violento alicia o seu vizinho, e guia-o por um caminho que não é bom.
verses.en_web: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
verses.en_bbe: A violent man puts desire of evil into his neighbour's mind, and makes him go in a way which is not good.

verses.en: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.pt: Quando fecha os olhos fá-lo para maquinar perversidades; quando morde os lábios, efetua o mal.
verses.en_web: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
verses.en_bbe: He whose eyes are shut is a man of twisted purposes, and he who keeps his lips shut tight makes evil come about.

verses.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.pt: Coroa de honra são as cãs, a qual se obtém no caminho da justiça.
verses.en_web: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: The grey head is a crown of glory, if it is seen in the way of righteousness.

verses.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.pt: Melhor é o longânimo do que o valente; e o que domina o seu espírito do que o que toma uma cidade.
verses.en_web: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
verses.en_bbe: He who is slow to be angry is better than a man of war, and he who has control over his spirit than he who takes a town.

verses.en: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
verses.pt: A sorte se lança no regaço; mas do Senhor procede toda a disposição dela.
verses.en_web: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: A thing may be put to the decision of chance, but it comes about through the Lord.
